summary: Repaired `/srv/inventory` on node1. Existing contents are preserved, permissions persist across reboot, and the OS/kernel remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created system group `inventory-readers` and non-login system user `inventorysvc`.
Set all existing inventory objects to `inventorysvc:inventory-readers`.
Set directories to 0750 and regular files to 0640.
Verified owner and reader-group access and denied unrelated-user access.
Safely restarted node1 and verified full recovery with a changed boot ID.

evidence.summary: All objects show inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership; directories are 0750, files are 0640. Independent access tests prove group readability and other-user denial.
Both files retain identical SHA-256 hashes before repair, after repair, and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved

evidence.summary: Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from c964b3f3-f889-46cc-9ffa-f94498ad16a1 to 533701e5-5976-4c45-af77-a4bc4e724460; services, identities, permissions, hashes, and access controls recovered successfully.
